plans.name: Single hotel
plans.for: A clear report on your hotel, every month.
features: A monthly report for each hotel: what AI says about it, who gets named instead, and what to fix first
A management PDF, plus the evidence behind every finding
Compared with last month, so you can see what moved
Your own questions tested, and your review export analysed

plans.name: Portfolio
plans.for: A live dashboard and ongoing analysis across all your hotels. Far more than a monthly report.
features: Everything in the monthly report, for every hotel
A portfolio dashboard: every hotel's score, trends and AI visibility side by side
See which hotels need attention, and which are improving
Actions tracked hotel by hotel, so you can see what has been done
Each hotel also gets its own dashboard, showing only that hotel
The same price for every hotel you add
